examples.english: I wrote out the paragraph in full.

miniContext: In full means including the whole of sth.

meaning: به اختیار خود، از روی انتخاب

examples.english: You didn't do that by choice, did you?
examples.persian: این کار را از روی اختیار خودت انجام ندادی، نه؟

miniContext: By choice means because you have chosen (to do sth).

examples.english: I got the job on the basis of my qualifications.
examples.persian: بر اساس مدارک تحصیلی‌ام آن شغل را گرفتم.

miniContext: On the basis of sth means because of sth.

examples.english: I'm hoping something will come up in the near future.
examples.persian: امیدوارم در آینده‌ی نزدیک کاری پیش بیاید.

miniContext: In the near future means soon.
By no means means not at all.

examples.english: Do you have to travel at short notice?
examples.persian: باید با اخطار کوتاه سفر کنی؟

miniContext: At short notice means with very little warning.

examples.english: I get a call and have to leave at once.
examples.persian: یک تماس می‌گیرم و باید فوراً بروم.

examples.english: You didn't ignore Suki on purpose, did you?
examples.persian: سوکی را عمداً نادیده نگرفتی، نه؟

miniContext: On purpose means not by accident; deliberately.

examples.english: Suki and I are on good terms.
examples.persian: من و سوکی رابطه‌ی خوبی با هم داریم.

miniContext: On good/friendly/bad terms means to have a good/friendly/bad relationship with sb.

examples.english: The government is out of touch with public mood.
examples.persian: دولت از حال‌وهوای مردم بی‌خبر است.

miniContext: Out of touch with sth means no longer having recent knowledge or information about sth.

examples.english: The tunnel was named in honour of the football coach.
examples.persian: تونل به افتخار مربی فوتبال نام‌گذاری شد.

miniContext: In honour of sb/sth means in order to show respect and admiration for sb/sth.

examples.english: We have had to put our holiday plans on hold.
examples.persian: مجبور شدیم برنامه‌ی تعطیلاتمان را به‌تعویق بیندازیم.

miniContext: On hold means delayed until a later time or date.

examples.english: If you are caught in possession of drugs, you will be in trouble.
examples.persian: اگر با مواد مخدر در اختیارت دستگیر شوی، دردسر خواهی داشت.

miniContext: In possession of sth means having or holding sth.

examples.english: She opened the can by means of a special device designed for the disabled.
examples.persian: او قوطی را به‌وسیله‌ی ابزار خاصی که برای معلولان طراحی شده بود باز کرد.

miniContext: By means of sth means with the help of sth.

examples.english: The government has been in office for five years.
examples.persian: دولت پنج سال است در قدرت است.

miniContext: In office means in a position of authority, especially in government.

examples.english: Hundreds came to the funeral out of respect for the bereaved family.
examples.persian: صدها نفر از روی احترام به خانواده‌ی داغدار به مراسم تشییع آمدند.

miniContext: Out of respect for sb means done because you care for sb/sth or think they are important.
